digest.component_or_area: DC renderer (wiki text markdown to HTML conversion)
propositions: A single pathological corpus body can hang pandoc's jira reader at 95.8% CPU for 13.5+ minutes with no timeout mechanism, stalling the entire reconcile indefinitely.
subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child process, not grandchildren or process groups, so a CPU-spinning pandoc pipe-holder survives timeout and remains orphaned.

Per-unit markdown rendering to HTML via pandoc must complete within a caller-side wall-clock timeout (default 10s) and degrade to raw markdown on timeout or non-zero exit, with the entire process group reaped via SIGTERM→grace→SIGKILL.

The pandoc binary is bundled in the pypandoc-binary wheel pinned to version 1.15 (pandoc 3.6.1, GPL-licensed) and this pin plus GPL provenance must be recorded in a repo-root NOTICE file and verified in CI.
